descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S03 Same ten sentences through the recovery engine (whisper-1, the Recover path)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)
  • U2 Drug names are transcribed correctly or visibly flagged when uncertain. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 4)
  • U3 A dictated Celsius temperature stays in Celsius: no conversion to Fahrenheit, no change of unit. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 5)
  • U5 The speech-to-text engine used is recorded for every run (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when the ambient option is on), alongside the note model. (UAT TC-23; UAT 3.9; TFA-94423 AC 7)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given The S01/S02 speech audio with no lead-in silence, transcoded to webm/opus (ffmpeg -c:a libopus) like the MediaRecorder recording the app keeps (it starts recording when the session opens), or the blob the app itself saved in S25 / S08 E-4; signed-in fresh account; …

When Each clip is posted to ai/transcribe:transcribeAudio with mimeType audio/webm, as the 'Recover note recording' button and the automatic recovery do

Then The returned text passes the same per-sentence checks as in S01/S02 (numbers, boundaries, occurrences); each call is logged as transcribe.transcribeAudio with model whisper-1

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Same per-sentence checks and 9/10 bar as S01/S02: a recovered transcript is what the physician reads after an interrupted take. Whether a whisper-1 transcript counts toward TC-23 is Q6. Unit test 'under the live route a saved recording is transcribed by the same vendor's batch model, and the log says so' (e2e/unit/live-session-action.unit.ts, unit config) already checks the ro …

Where it ran: local aicheck-dictation (dictation AI checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa

Not judged yet: transcription through the whisper-1 recovery path is blocked on the same local OpenAI key approval.

Evidence: allure-results/1204f6e7…: the whisper-1 batch run is built and its --dry run validated 10+4 clips; blocked by the same key precondition.

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-23/S01; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-dictation.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-dictation.
